evals.setup: `../style/SKILL.md` already carries a receiver-naming rule. The session issues three rule edits in turn.
evals.query: /review add "no naked returns in tests", then /review change "receivers are three letters", then /review remove "the compile-time check rule"

evals.name: learn-from-the-session
evals.setup: A finished session with four corrections. Two are genuinely absent from `../style/SKILL.md`: the user rejected a package-level `var` used as mutable state between calls, and asked that a constructor returning `(*T, error)` validate its arguments before allocating. One repeats a rule the rulebook already carries verbatim — never store a `context.Context` in a struct field. The fourth was a rename specific to this project's domain vocabulary.

evals.name: learn-finds-nothing-new
